bio: Located in the Reynoldstown neighborhood in East Atlanta, Home Grown is a classic all-day breakfast and lunch spot complete with knotty pine paneling and booth seating. While it has a retro feel to it, don't assume you know everything on this menu. Instead, expect oodles of Southern charm and definitely ask about the daily specials, since you may come across items like house-made tamales, Gulf red snapper tacos, lasagna or even a pu pu platter with frog legs and crab claws. The focused menu stays largely local in both theme and sourcing, delivering country cooking that never disappoints. Case in point? That open-faced buttermilk biscuit layered with perfectly crisp chicken drowned in hearty pork sausage gravy, of course....
